content: Multi-format rmarkdown rendering gotchas: (1) LaTeX math — wrapping in $$ is safe for HTML but can break pdflatex; use \aligned not \align; pandoc passes LaTeX directly to pdflatex in PDF mode. (2) Plotly in static formats (PDF/Word/Markdown) — printing a plotly object in non-HTML output produces a PNG screenshot via webshot/webshot2 which requires headless Chrome (chromote); always_allow_html: yes does not guarantee PDF plot rendering. Without webshot2 installed, plotly in PDF/Word renders blank. (3) Non-ASCII characters — pdflatex has limited Unicode support; use %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}; &/</> in parameter values are XML special chars that silently break Word docx generation. (4) Figure directory deletion bug — render(output_format='all') may delete figure directories still needed by other output formats. (5) Conditional generation needed — use knitr::is_latex_output() and knitr::is_html_output() to conditionally generate format-specific elements. (6) Figure paths differ per format — fig.path changes based on output format. (7) knitr cache with RNG — knitr caches .Random.seed per chunk; set.seed() in first chunk ensures reproducibility.
